title: Berserk
desc:
Guts, known as the Black Swordsman, seeks sanctuary from the demonic forces attracted to him and his woman because of a demonic mark on their necks, and also vengeance against the man who branded him as an unholy sacrifice. Aided only by his titanic strength gained from a harsh childhood lived with mercenaries, a gigantic sword, and an iron prosthetic left hand, Guts must struggle against his bleak destiny, all the while fighting with a rage that might strip him of his humanity.
___
Won the 6th Osamu Tezuka Cultural Prize Excellence Award in 2002.

Note: Following Miura Kenta's death in 2021, the series has been taken over by Kouji Mori, who supervises the series with art done by Studio Gaga.

title: Berserk Gaiden
desc:
A joke comic series drawn by the creator of Berserk about Berserk but hardly has anything to do with it. It gives some insight into the 97 anime production and Miuras' life. The main characters are Miura and Puck who's there mainly to mess with Miura.

These chapters were published in multiple places and so are hard to find.

Chapters and where they were published:
1. 「ベルセルク外伝　真夜中の聖戦 」Young Animal Issue #24 1997
2. 「ベルセルク外伝２　奪われしパンドラの箱」 Young Animal Berserk Special Blitzkrieg Issue, May 5, 1998
3. 「ベルセルク外伝３　南海奇行ネオマンガ」Berserk Side Story 3 South Sea Eccentric Neo Manga | October 1998 / Berselk OFFICIAL SITE/shockwave or jpeg/15 | Link to the chapter is at the bottom of this blog entry from Miura [but it's contents is now lost media](https://web.archive.org/web/19991104215944/http://www.hakusensha.co.jp/berserk/ken_diary02.html)
4. 「ベルセルク外伝４　電脳ジャッカー」 "Berserk Sword Wind Chronicles Complete Analysis Book", December 9, 1998, (97 anime art book)

Kentarou Miura's 4 Koma GAG Festival chapters:

5. 『かばんの中』 Young Animal Issue #13 1997 (along with Berserk Episode 102)
6. 『因果だほい』Young Animal Issue #1 1998, December 26, 1997 (along with Berserk Episode 112)
7. 『ザ グレート インパクト キャット』 Young Animal Issue #10 1999 (along with Berserk Episode 141)

title: Berserk Memorial
desc:
Memorial for Kentaro Miura from the final chapter of 'Berserk'.

Will continue to chapter 1 whenever Mori-san will get to publishing it.

title: Berserk obżarstwa
desc: In this world, there are two types of people. Those Who have powerful "skills", and those who don't. People born with powerful skills, exterminate monsters to level up and become successful, while people without them, become failures, who are treated harshly by society. Follow the story of Fate, a guy who works as a gatekeeper, and whose only skill is gluttony, a skill that only makes him hungry.
